python3 << 'EOF'
import numpy as np

# Individual income tax receipts (net of refunds) for FY 1929-1942
# From treasury bulletin 1942_07 page 76 (in thousands of dollars)
data = {
    1929: 1095541,
    1930: 1146845,
    1931: 833648,
    1932: 427191,
    1933: 352573,
    1934: 419509,
    1935: 527113,
    1936: 674416,
    1937: 1091741,
    1938: 1286312,
    1939: 1028834,
    1940: 982017,
    1941: 1417655,
    1942: 3262800
}

# Convert to billions (divide by 1,000,000)
years = np.array(list(data.keys()))
receipts = np.array([v / 1_000_000 for v in data.values()])

print("Years:", years)
print("Receipts (billions):", receipts)

# OLS regression: receipts = beta0 + beta1 * year
X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(years)), years])
beta = np.linalg.lstsq(X, receipts, rcond=None)[0]

print(f"\nRegression: receipts = {beta[0]:.6f} + {beta[1]:.6f} * year")

# Project for year 2000
year_2000 = 2000
projected = beta[0] + beta[1] * year_2000
print(f"\nProjected for FY 2000: {projected:.6f} billions")

# Actual FY 2000 individual income tax receipts (net)
# From treasury bulletin 2001_12 page 17: 1,004,461 million = 1004.461 billion
actual_2000 = 1004461 / 1000  # Convert million to billion
print(f"Actual FY 2000: {actual_2000:.3f} billions")

# Difference
diff = actual_2000 - projected
print(f"\nDifference (actual - projected): {diff:.3f} billions")
print(f"Rounded to nearest tenth: {round(diff, 1)}")
EOF
